chatbot.title: Chat with us
chatbot.welcome: Hi! I'm here to help. You can ask me about our opening hours, how to book an appointment, contact details, tariffs, or anything else about our dental cabinet. What would you like to know?
chatbot.default: I'm not sure I understood. I can help you with: opening hours, how to book or cancel an appointment, our contact details, tariffs, prescriptions, or where we're located. Try asking one of these, or rephrase your question!
chatbot.hours: We're open Tuesday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, and on Saturday for surgery only. We're closed on Sunday and Monday. If you need a slot outside these times, leave us a message and we'll get back to you.
chatbot.booking: To book an appointment: create an account or log in, then go to Appointments → Request appointment. Choose your preferred date and time; our team will confirm it within about 24 hours. You can also see alternative slots if your first choice isn't available.
chatbot.contact: You can reach us at: Address — 123 Main Street, Gafsa. Phone — +216 12 345 678. Email — contact@dentassist.com. You'll also find this in the "Our cabinet" section at the bottom of the homepage.
chatbot.tariffs: Our basic consultation is 70 DT. For other services (cleaning, scaling, extraction, whitening, etc.), the full list and prices are on the Tariffs page in your patient dashboard. Prices may vary slightly depending on the procedure.
chatbot.cancel: To cancel an appointment, go to My Appointments in your dashboard, open the appointment and use the Cancel option. We recommend cancelling at least 24 hours in advance so we can offer the slot to another patient. Thank you!
chatbot.prescriptions: All your prescriptions are in the Prescriptions section of your dashboard. You can open or download each PDF from there. If you don't see a recent one, give us a call and we'll sort it out.
chatbot.controls: Follow-up (control) dates are set by your doctor after a visit. You'll find them in the Control dates section of your dashboard. If you have a date coming up and need to change it, please contact us.
chatbot.firstVisit: For your first visit: create an account on DentAssist, then request an appointment (Appointments → Request appointment). Bring an ID and, if you have any, your previous dental records or X-rays. We'll take care of the rest and make you feel welcome!
chatbot.emergency: If you're in severe pain or have a dental emergency, please call us directly at +216 12 345 678 so we can advise you or fit you in as soon as possible. For life-threatening emergencies, go to the nearest hospital or call emergency services.
chatbot.location: We're at 123 Main Street, Gafsa. You'll find a map and full contact details in the "Our cabinet" section on the homepage. If you have trouble finding us, give us a call and we'll guide you.
chatbot.greeting: Hello! 👋 I'm the DentAssist assistant. I can help you with opening hours, booking or cancelling appointments, our contact details, tariffs, and more. What would you like to know?
chatbot.thanks: You're welcome! If you have any other questions, just ask. Have a great day!
